to the kiln.

    The Tier 2 approach assumptions about the lime industry:2006 IPCC Guidelines, Volume 3, Chapter 2, page 2.24 (Lime production sector, default values table)
IPCC Emission Factor Database 2.A.2 Lime production lists 1.02 as default CF_lkd for India and many other countries.
Indian GHG Inventory and cement/lime sector tools incorporate this 2% LKD correction factor for estimating production emissions in the absence of plant-specific data.
GHG Protocol lime tools and Indian Cement sector emission calculation tools use 1.02 as default or starting point
